answer: Pin each identity to one real place: five landmark nodes ping it each epoch, and replies must land inside a 40 ms window for its region. Clones sharing one rack cannot fake five distances at once, so physics exposes it. Each failed probe costs 25 POA, and three failures in 10 epochs suspends it for 30 days. A farm that tries to wander the map ends its voyage at one timing signature, pinned by ferrous proof no alias can forge.
